# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the resulting behaviour and link the relevant design or issue.

## Type Of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Maintenance or workflow update

## Motivation And Context

Explain the problem, the chosen contract, alternatives, and compatibility impact.

## Testing

- [ ] Ran the relevant local checks
- [ ] Added or updated meaningful tests
- [ ] Recorded native toolchain/platform evidence when applicable
- [ ] Updated documentation and support claims

## Contributor Checklist

- [ ] This change delivers one coherent contract.
- [ ] Commit messages and this title follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Development commits are signed with a GitHub-supported method.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or unsupported telemetry claims are included.
